name: isolation-api-tests
description: An API testing framework with custom FastAPI mocks for service isolation. Tests real HTTP/gRPC interactions, Kafka events and PostgreSQL data.

name: performance-tests
description: A Locust-based load testing framework with decoupled HTTP/gRPC clients, automated test data seeding, Prometheus/Grafana monitoring and CI/CD reporting.

name: autotest-ui
description: A Playwright-based UI testing framework with Page Object architecture, parallel cross-browser execution, reusable authentication state, Allure reporting and CI/CD.
